text:
maria: Quick sync — Enterprise prospect wants a fully air-gapped POC. Key asks: offline installer, signed artifacts, no outbound telemetry, and a 3-month proposed upgrade cadence question. Need cost for a 30-day reserved POC. Any blockers?
kevin: We can do an offline bundle. Two options: full immutable bundle (~12GB) or delta chunks (~200MB each) for patching. Both signed with our release key.
kevin: Important: delta updates require a small bootstrap agent that validates signatures and applies chunks locally. That bootstrap needs network only for initial transfer (sneakernet allowed).
eli: KMS/HSM note: we support customer KMS via PKCS#11 for private deployments, but in strictly air-gapped sites customers usually provide an HSM appliance reachable from the cluster. If completely isolated, we can ship a sealed signing token for activation (manual rotation).
sasha: For the 30-day POC pricing — standard practice is a time-limited reserved node discount plus a one-time engineering setup fee for air-gapped packaging and keying. I'll put numbers in a follow-up, but expect setup fee + 30-day reserved capacity line item.
julie: Security checklist highlights: telemetry must be opt-out by default for air-gapped. We also need to confirm:
- disk encryption (dm-crypt/LUKS) supported? yes, with customer-managed keys.
- audit logs export: logs are stored locally and can be pulled via tarball.
- FIPS build: available on request but increases build time.
maria: Customer also asked about upgrade cadence — they want upgrades only quarterly with emergency hotfix capability. Is that alignment OK?
kevin: Quarterly is fine. For hotfixes we can do signed patch chunks. We recommend a staged QA on their side: staging cluster -> canary -> prod. For air-gapped, rollout is manual via the bootstrap tool.
eli: Operational constraints: certificate rotation requires a short maintenance window and either physical access or pre-shared rotation tokens. We'll need to document exact steps in the runbook.
deploy-bot: Created ticket INF-2147 with runbook draft: https://go.internal/runbooks/INF-2147 (internal) :thumbsup:
sasha: Also confirm licensing/activation: for air-gapped POCs we can issue time-limited license file bound to host fqdn or a hardware fingerprint. Activation is offline via signed license token exchange.
julie: On questionnaires — we can supply a sanitized SCP of the security answers and a SOC2 excerpt. We'll redact internal IPs. Also call out that telemetry is fully disabled for air-gapped installs.
maria: Great. Any production SLA or uptime blockers for a 30-day POC? Customer asked about RTO/RPO expectations if they hit trouble.
Kevin: (typo) kevin: For POC we provide business-hours support with a 4-hour response target for Sev1 and 1 business-day for lower. Enterprise SLA (24/7) requires add-on.
sasha: Action items:
- kevin: ship bundle options + small doc on delta vs full by EOD tomorrow.
- eli: HSM/activation runbook snippet and cert rotation steps by Tue.
- sasha: draft POC quote (30-day reserved nodes + setup fee) by EOD.
- julie: sanitized security Q&A + telemetry confirmation by Tue.
- maria: coordinate customer window and confirm hardware fingerprint method.
maria: Thanks all — I'll book a 30-min sync with the customer once we have the bundle doc and quote. :rocket:
